signs.104: Bend to the right, then to the left.
signs.105: Bend to the left, then to the right.
signs.107: Warning and guidance at a sharp bend (to the left): continue in the direction of the arrows on the sign, passing in front of the sign.
signs.108: Warning and guidance at a sharp bend (to the right): continue in the direction of the arrows on the sign, passing in front of the sign.
signs.112: Narrow passage or obstacle. If the sign is placed on one side of the road only, the obstacle is on that side. The diagonal stripes slope down towards the centre of the adjacent lane.
signs.113: Height limit: passage lower than 4.80 m.
signs.115: Side road joining from the right (T-junction to the right).
signs.116: Side road joining from the left (T-junction to the left).
signs.118: Warning and guidance at a T-junction: continue in the directions of the arrows on the sign, passing in front of the sign.
signs.119: Side road from the right, then from the left.
signs.120: Side road from the left, then from the right.
signs.123: A road with right of way merges with a secondary road on the right; there is no turn into the secondary road.
signs.124: A road with right of way merges with a secondary road on the left; there is no turn into the secondary road.
signs.125: Merging with a main road from the right (it has right of way); no right turn.
signs.126: Merging with a main road from the left (it has right of way); no left turn.
signs.133: Location of a railway crossing — single track.
signs.134: Location of a railway crossing — more than one track.
signs.147: Crossing with an exit for work vehicles or tractors.
signs.148: Guide and warning posts at the roadside: a square reflector marks the right side of the road, two round reflectors mark the left side.
signs.149: Black-and-white or yellow-and-white guide or separation post.
signs.150: Danger spot for which there is no specific sign.
signs.201: Proceed straight on or turn right. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501). A U-turn to the right is allowed unless forbidden by another sign.
signs.202: Proceed straight on or turn left. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501). A U-turn to the left is allowed unless forbidden by another sign.
signs.203: Proceed straight on. If the arrow points diagonally, drive in the direction of the arrow. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501).
signs.204: Turn right. Turn before the sign. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501).
signs.205: Turn left. Turn before the sign. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501).
signs.206: Turn right. Turn after the sign. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501). A U-turn to the right is allowed.
signs.207: Turn left. Turn after the sign. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501). A U-turn to the left is allowed.
signs.208: Turn right or left. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport (sign 501). A U-turn to the right or left is allowed.
signs.209: Proceed straight on or make a U-turn to the right; a U-turn to the left is forbidden. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport.
signs.210: Proceed straight on or make a U-turn to the left; a U-turn to the right is forbidden. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport.
signs.211: U-turn to the right. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport.
signs.212: U-turn to the left. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport.
signs.213: Pass the marked place on the right or on the left. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport only.
signs.214: Pass the marked place on the right. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport only.
signs.215: Pass the marked place on the left. A yellow arrow shows the direction for public transport only.
signs.216: Entrance to a freeway (motorway): no entry for pedestrians, bicycles, handcarts, animals and any vehicle that cannot or may not travel at the minimum set speed.
signs.218: Road for motor vehicles that can and may travel at no less than the speed shown on the sign (km/h).
signs.220: Shared street (residential zone): pedestrians and vehicles share the same space.
signs.224: One-way bicycle lane. Riding is allowed only in the direction indicated by marking 804.
signs.228: Shared path for pedestrians and cyclists.
signs.229: Separate paths: one for pedestrians and one for cyclists.
signs.230: Toll road or toll lane: driving is allowed on payment of the toll according to the law in force.
signs.231: End of toll road or toll lane.
signs.301: Give way to traffic on the crossing road, including rail tracks.
signs.302: Stop! Give way to traffic on the crossing road, including rail tracks.
signs.303: Roundabout: give way to traffic moving around the circle or on rail tracks. Drive around the circle keeping it on your left (pass on its right side).
signs.304: Stop! (portable sign used by a traffic controller).
signs.305: Proceed with caution (portable sign used by a traffic controller).
signs.306: Give way to pedestrians crossing the road.
signs.307: Give way to oncoming traffic on a narrow section of road.
signs.308: You have priority over oncoming traffic on a narrow section of road.
signs.309: Main road: you have right of way.
signs.310: End of the road on which you have right of way.
signs.401: Road closed in both directions to all vehicles. If the sign is placed above a traffic light, driving straight on is forbidden.
signs.403: Barrier: the road is closed. If a sign showing a direction is placed, you may drive only in that direction.
signs.404: Barrier before a railway crossing: if the barrier is lowering, rising or horizontal, stop before it and do not proceed.
signs.405: No entry for any motor vehicle.
signs.406: No entry for commercial motor vehicles whose permitted total weight exceeds the weight shown on the sign (tonnes).
signs.407: No entry for vehicles carrying hazardous materials that must be marked by law, except for fuel and gas deliveries.
signs.408: No entry for motor vehicles other than two-wheelers.
signs.410: No entry for work vehicles and tractors.
signs.414: No entry for pedestrians, work vehicles, tractors, animals or bicycles — whichever are shown on the sign.
signs.415: No entry for any vehicle whose permitted total weight exceeds the weight shown on the sign (tonnes).
signs.416: No entry for vehicles whose height including load exceeds the height shown on the sign (metres).
signs.417: No entry for vehicles whose width including load exceeds the width shown on the sign (metres).
signs.418: Zone where driving lessons are forbidden.
signs.419: End of the zone where driving lessons are forbidden.
signs.420: No overtaking: it is forbidden to overtake or pass motor vehicles with more than two wheels travelling in the same direction.
signs.422: Vehicles with a permitted total weight over 4 tonnes may not overtake or pass motor vehicles with more than two wheels travelling in the same direction.
signs.423: End of the no-overtaking section for vehicles over 4 tonnes.
signs.426: Speed limit: driving faster than the speed shown on the sign (km/h) is forbidden.
signs.428: No right turn at the nearest turn. If the sign is placed above a traffic light, turning, including a U-turn, is forbidden.
signs.429: No left turn at the nearest turn. If the sign is placed above a traffic light, turning, including a U-turn, is forbidden.
signs.430: No U-turn to the right at the nearest turn.
signs.431: No U-turn to the left at the nearest turn.
signs.432: No parking on the side of the road where the sign is placed.
signs.433: No stopping or parking on the side of the road where the sign is placed, except as permitted by law.
signs.435: Zone where vehicles with a permitted total weight over 10,000 kg may not park.
signs.436: End of the zone where commercial vehicles over 10,000 kg may not park.
signs.437: Parking only for a disabled person's vehicle with a valid original disability badge, when the vehicle is used by the disabled person to whom the badge was issued.
signs.439: Plate for a mandatory instruction for which there is no sign in the table. If placed under another sign, it supplements it.
signs.440: Zone where polluting vehicles may not enter (under the Clean Air Law).
signs.441: End of the zone where polluting vehicles may not enter.
signs.501: Road or lane for public transport of the kinds shown on the sign, and for cars carrying at least the number of passengers shown.
signs.504: All vehicles may drive in the direction of the white arrow. Vehicles allowed by sign 501 may also drive in the opposite direction.
signs.505: Stop for public buses and route vehicles. Stopping as shown on the sign.
signs.507: Taxi rank: stopping and parking of any other vehicle is forbidden, except for dropping off passengers.
signs.509: Taxi stop for picking up and dropping off passengers only. Stopping and parking of other vehicles is forbidden.
signs.510: Stop for soldiers' transport — for picking up and dropping off only.
signs.601: Name of an interchange or junction: white letters on blue on a freeway, white letters on green on other roads. The number on plate 630 is the distance in metres.
signs.602: Overhead lane direction sign before an interchange on an interurban road: white on blue on a freeway, white on green on other roads.
signs.603: Overhead lane direction sign to tourist sites before a junction on an interurban road — white letters on a brown background.
signs.604: Advance direction sign before a junction on an interurban road; to tourist sites — white letters on a brown background.
signs.605: Two consecutive exits close to each other: to a freeway — white on blue, to other roads — white on green.
signs.606: Exit sign: to a freeway — white on blue, to other roads — white on green.
signs.607: Overhead sign for the exit at the nearest interchange only: to a freeway — white on blue, to other roads — white on green.
signs.609: Next exits: white on blue on a freeway, white on green on other roads. The number is the distance to the exit in kilometres.
signs.610: Places (destinations) on the road ahead. The number is the distance in kilometres to the centre of the place.
signs.611: Road number: freeway — blue, main road — red, regional road — green, local road — black.
signs.612: Road kilometre number: freeway — blue, main road — red, regional road — green, local road — black. The arrow shows the direction of numbering.
signs.613: Lane allocation by direction: white arrows on blue on a freeway, white arrows on green on other roads. A yellow arrow marks a public transport lane.
signs.614: Direction sign on urban roads: destinations outside the city — white on blue, within the city — white on green, tourist sites — white on brown.
signs.615: Overhead lane sign before an interchange on an urban road: destinations outside the city — white on blue, within the city — white on green.
signs.616: Overhead lane sign before a junction on an urban road: destinations outside the city — white on blue, within the city — white on green.
signs.617: Direction sign at a junction or interchange: to a freeway — white on blue, to other roads — black on white.
signs.618: One-way road: entry to a section where traffic may move only in the direction of the arrow.
signs.619: Change in the number of lanes: lanes are added on the right. A yellow arrow marks a lane for public transport only.
signs.620: Change in the number of lanes: lanes are added on the left. A yellow arrow marks a lane for public transport only.
signs.621: Change in the number of lanes: lanes end on the right. A yellow arrow marks a lane for public transport only.
signs.622: Change in the number of lanes: lanes end on the left. A yellow arrow marks a lane for public transport only.
signs.626: Parking for vehicles (except at bus stops and light rail stations marked by signs 505 or 506).
signs.627: Parking on the pavement is allowed for vehicles with a permitted total weight up to 2,200 kg — as marked, and without blocking a reasonable passage for pedestrians.
signs.628: End of the place or section where parking on the road or pavement is allowed by signs 626 or 627.
signs.629: Plate for a warning or information for which there is no sign in the table. If placed under another sign, it supplements it.
signs.629פ: Plate for a warning or information for which there is no sign in the table (electronic sign). If placed under another sign, it supplements it.
signs.630: At the distance shown in metres, the sign above which or inside which the plate is placed applies.
signs.631: The sign above the plate applies along the section shown in metres.
signs.632: The instruction of the sign above the plate applies after the turn — for those turning in the direction of the arrow.
signs.636: One-way road for motor vehicles: bicycles may also ride in the opposite direction.
signs.638: Place for picking up and dropping off passengers.
signs.701: Red light: stop! If a sign with an arrow (arrows) is placed above the traffic light, the signal applies to the directions shown. Stop before the stop line, or if there is none, before the pedestrian crossing or next to the nearest traffic light. Crossing the stop line or entering the junction while the light is red is forbidden.
signs.702: Red and yellow lights together: stay stopped as for sign 701 until the green light appears. Get ready to move off.
signs.703: Green light: you may go straight on, turn right, turn left or make a U-turn, unless a sign above the traffic light says otherwise. A flashing green light means the green is ending and yellow will come on soon.
signs.705: Yellow light: stop as for sign 701. If you cannot stop safely before the junction or have already entered it, complete the crossing and clear the junction immediately.
signs.706: Flashing yellow light: proceed with caution, observing all the rules. If the light is at a pedestrian or bicycle crossing, let the pedestrian or cyclist cross safely.
signs.718: Red figure of a standing pedestrian: do not start crossing the road; if you are already on the roadway, clear it immediately.
signs.719: Green figure of a pedestrian: you may cross the road with caution.
signs.720: Red bicycle figure: do not start crossing the road; if you are already on the roadway, clear it immediately. (721 — green bicycle figure: you may cross the road with caution.)
signs.723: Lane closed: driving in the lane above which this signal is placed is forbidden until sign 426פ, 724 or 724פ, or until the nearest junction. (724 — lane open.)
signs.723פ: Lane closed (electronic sign): driving in the lane above which this signal is placed is forbidden until sign 426פ, 724 or 724פ, or until the nearest junction.
signs.724פ: Lane open (electronic sign): driving in the lane above which this signal is placed is allowed.
signs.805: Frequent broken white line — warning before a double solid dividing line begins: move to the right lane before the double solid line starts.
signs.901: Roadworks. Follow the orange markings if present.
signs.903: Warning and guidance at a sharp bend: slow down and continue only in the direction of the arrows, passing in front of the sign.
signs.904: Warning and guidance at a T-junction: slow down and continue only in the directions of the arrows, passing in front of the sign.
signs.908: Narrow passage or obstacle. If the sign is placed on one side of the road only, the obstacle is on that side.
signs.910: Change in the number of lanes: lanes are added on the right.
signs.911: Change in the number of lanes: lanes are added on the left.
signs.912: Change in the number of lanes: lanes end on the right.
signs.913: Change in the number of lanes: lanes end on the left.
signs.914: Traffic diversion (shift of the traffic flow).
signs.915: Plate for a warning, instruction, prohibition or information for which there is no sign in the table. If placed under another sign, it supplements it.
signs.916: At the distance shown in metres, the sign above which the plate is placed applies.
signs.917: The sign above the plate applies along the section shown in metres.
signs.929: Barrier (in a works zone): the road is closed. If a sign showing a direction is placed, you may drive only in that direction.
signs.935: Emergency stopping bay in a roadworks zone.
